requirements.quote:
If the server chooses to accept the "early_data" extension, then it
   MUST comply with the same error-handling requirements specified for
   all records when processing early data records.
requirements.condition: when a server accepts early_data and processes early-data records
requirements.required_behavior: apply the error-handling requirements specified for all records
requirements.forbidden_behavior: apply weaker record error handling because a record is early data
requirements.error_behavior: use the standard record error-handling paths
requirements.why_checkable: The early-record path can be compared with the ordinary record failure paths.

requirements.quote:
Specifically, if the
   server fails to decrypt a 0-RTT record following an accepted
   "early_data" extension, it MUST terminate the connection with a
   "bad_record_mac" alert as per Section 5.2.
requirements.condition: when a server fails to decrypt a 0-RTT record after accepting early_data
requirements.forbidden_behavior: discard the undecryptable record and continue the connection
requirements.error_behavior: terminate the connection with a bad_record_mac alert
requirements.why_checkable: A decryption failure after acceptance has a specific alert and terminal outcome.

requirements.quote: A TLS implementation SHOULD NOT automatically resend early data;
requirements.condition: when early data has been rejected
requirements.required_behavior: leave the retransmission decision to the application
requirements.why_checkable: The rejected-early-data path can be checked for automatic application-data replay.

requirements.quote:
A TLS implementation MUST NOT automatically resend
   early data unless the negotiated connection selects the same ALPN
   protocol.
requirements.condition: when early data has been rejected and the negotiated connection selects a different ALPN protocol
requirements.why_checkable: The retransmission branch can compare the original and negotiated ALPN values before sending.
